name: Semantic Deformation Registry
purpose: Track how meaning deforms under sequentialization, flattening, projection reduction, and recursive reinterpretation.

deformation_classes.definition: Loss of simultaneous meaning context in favor of a linear causal interpretation.
Reduction of complex semantic aspect roles into a single priority perspective.
Interpretive drift where a partial projection is misread as the complete source relation.
The removal of mandatory semantic tensions in favor of artificial coherence.
Language drift where analytical analogs are promoted to physical or primitive claims.

mandatory_rules.rule: Semantic deformation must remain explicit and traceable to the source neighborhood.
Flattening (SD_FLATTENING) cannot silently remove mandatory projection conflicts.
Interpretive simplification requires an explicit projection-loss declaration.

governance_rules.rule: Any deformation resulting in SD_ONTOLOGY_DRIFT triggers immediate REJECT_ESCALATION.

forbidden_claims: Sequentialization derives the literal 'flow of time'.
Coherent interpretation justifies the erasure of contradictory aspect roles.
